title: Rainbow Sprayer on Floating Isle
description: A stylized purple-skinned figure with flowing blue and green hair stands on a small floating platform covered in colorful flowers, spraying a swirling rainbow from a blue bottle. Below, waterfalls cascade from the platform into a dark cyberpunk cityscape with a glowing red sun in the background.
prompt: A surreal scene of a purple-skinned character with long flowing turquoise and blue hair wearing a striped jacket, standing on a small grassy floating platform covered with vibrant flowers and small blue creatures. The character is spraying a swirling rainbow mist from a blue spray can. Waterfalls pour from the edges of the platform down into a dark futuristic city below. A large glowing red sun sits on the horizon against a black sky with constellation lines. Vibrant colors, dripping paint effects, psychedelic street art style.
